title: Print-first pocket-card template (B/W, fold-to-pocket PDF + Markdown)
context: Packs are used in the field, often offline and on paper, so the primary output format is a black-and-white, fold-to-pocket print card rendered from Markdown to PDF. The template defines that print-first layout. It depends on the criticality rubric so tiering and the mandatory disclaimer are surfaced consistently.
objective: Design the print-first pocket-card template (B/W, fold-to-pocket) as PDF spec plus Markdown source.
acceptanceCriteria: Template renders a black-and-white, fold-to-pocket card from Markdown to PDF without color dependence
Surfaces phrase tiering, pictograms, and the mandatory disclaimer legibly at pocket size
Includes a locale slot for the verified emergency number and protocol note
Documents the render path so packs/<scenario>/<lang>/<locale>/pack.pdf and pack.md can be produced reproducibly
